items.q: What is the Daily BTC Briefing?
items.a: A daily operational read of the BTC futures market (BTC/USDT), produced by RBX Systems. Each edition consolidates context, scenarios and a flight plan into six auditable artifacts. It is not buy or sell signals and it is not investment advice.

items.q: When and how do I receive the briefing?
items.a: Every business day, by 07h00 Brasília time. On the Pro plan it is delivered to your WhatsApp; on the Free plan you read the day's edition and the last 7 days in the logged-in area with your Google account.

Free: $0, with reading in the logged-in area. Pro: $12 per month billed monthly or $120 per year billed annually, paid in USDT through the RBX BTCPay Server or by card. The Team plan charges the Pro per-seat price for 2 to 50 seats on a single invoice.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: You can cancel any time, with no lock-in. The subscription is managed by RBX Systems; talk to the team through the contact form or the email listed in the Legal Notice.

items.q: Who is the BTC Briefing for?
items.a: For people who follow the BTC futures market and want a daily, auditable operational read with no promise of returns. It is not for anyone looking for buy and sell signals or investment recommendations.
